titulo.alumno:
«Не столько…, сколько…»
Contrast: not so much… as…

intro: Не столько X, сколько Y shifts the emphasis: Y better describes the cause, the scope or the assessment.

frases.estudio: Проблема была не столько технической, сколько организационной.
frases.alumno: The problem was not so much technical as organisational.

frases.estudio: Проект важен не столько из-за масштаба, сколько из-за последствий.
frases.alumno: The project matters not so much because of its scale as because of its consequences.

texto: Не столько X, сколько Y shifts the emphasis: Y better describes the cause, the scope or the assessment.
The second part corrects or specifies the first; the comma normally separates the members of the construction.

pregunta.texto: Which aspect is presented as more decisive in the second sentence?

opciones.explicacion: Сколько introduces the aspect to which the emphasis shifts.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
